summary: Backend-only M3 verification against live control plane. Ran pytest suite covering all 9 review-request scenarios except the OPTIONAL live extraction (skipped by design — freezing a warm draft dispatches real bounded reads). Result: 13/15 assertions PASS. Two assertions FAIL for the same legacy request req-c1f2738b3449081569aebfbfd537e2a6: lifecycle_state is still 'Blocked' (expected 'Interrupted') and POST /commission/{id}/advance still returns HTTP 409 'This request is closed' (expected 200 with terminal.phase='held'). Session fix (3) from the review-request ('holds ending _REQUIRED are Interrupted, not Blocked') has NOT been applied to legacy hold reason_code EXECUTION_HELD which this request carries.

critical.issue: lifecycle_state='Blocked', permitted_actions=[]; review-request requires 'Interrupted' with permitted_actions ['retry','stop']. Root cause: services/portal_operational/execution_records.py:_state maps reason to 'Interrupted' only when reason.endswith(('_UNBOUND','_NOT_BOUND','_UNAVAILABLE','_REQUIRED')) or 'UNCERTAIN' in reason. This legacy hold's reason_code is 'EXECUTION_HELD' (from history event 'execution_held' with ADMISSION_UNRESOLVED) which matches none of those suffixes and falls through to 'Blocked'. The fix promised in the review-request (interrupted for _REQUIRED holds) never triggers here — either the transient set must include 'EXECUTION_HELD'/'ADMISSION_UNRESOLVED' or the terminal reason_code must be re-derived to *_REQUIRED before the state helper runs.

Returns HTTP 409 {"detail":"This request is closed; any new commission requires a fresh request."}. Review-request requires 200 with terminal.phase='held' (reason may be ARTIFACT_REGISTRATION_CHANGED or EXECUTION_HELD). Same root cause as above — because lifecycle is 'Blocked', the advance router treats the record as closed. Fixing the lifecycle-state mapping will also fix this endpoint.

action_items: Extend services/portal_operational/execution_records.py:_state (or its caller) to classify reason_code 'EXECUTION_HELD' / event 'execution_held' with 'ADMISSION_UNRESOLVED' as an Interrupted/retryable state for legacy holds. Verify GET /api/portal/requests/req-c1f2738b3449081569aebfbfd537e2a6 returns lifecycle_state 'Interrupted' with permitted_actions ['retry','stop'] and POST /commission/.../advance returns 200 with terminal.phase='held'.
After fixing, re-run /app/backend/tests/m3_commission/test_m3_live_bindings.py — the two TestInterruptedRun cases should pass.
critical_code_review_comments: services/portal_operational/execution_records.py:_state uses a suffix-based classifier for transient reasons; legacy reason codes without an *_UNAVAILABLE/_REQUIRED suffix (here 'EXECUTION_HELD') are silently classified as terminal 'Blocked'. Prefer an explicit set of transient reason codes (or an is_retryable flag on the hold record) rather than string-suffix heuristics — the current heuristic already fails for real data.

The 409 advance response wording ('This request is closed; any new commission requires a fresh request.') will be user-facing for every legacy Interrupted-should-be record; that is the wrong operator message for a retryable hold.
Budget structure returned by /run is a list keyed by 'dimension' (not 'name'); the review-request wording uses 'row named X consumed Y' — non-breaking, but flagging for docs consistency.

rca of the issue: Legacy request req-c1f2738b3449081569aebfbfd537e2a6 was frozen 2026-09-29T15:21:49 and its terminal reason_code is 'EXECUTION_HELD' (history shows event 'execution_held' with reason_code 'ADMISSION_UNRESOLVED' at the routing step). _state() in services/portal_operational/execution_records.py maps a reason to 'Interrupted' only when it ends with _UNBOUND, _NOT_BOUND, _UNAVAILABLE or _REQUIRED, or contains 'UNCERTAIN'. EXECUTION_HELD matches none of those, so it lands on 'Blocked'. Consequently permitted_actions is [] (only Interrupted maps to ['retry','stop']) and the advance router treats Blocked as closed, returning 409. Reproduction: (a) GET /api/portal/requests/req-c1f2738b3449081569aebfbfd537e2a6 → lifecycle_state 'Blocked'. (b) POST /api/portal/commission/req-c1f2738b3449081569aebfbfd537e2a6/advance → 409 'This request is closed…'. Mitigation options: (i) add 'EXECUTION_HELD' to the transient set (or use an explicit retryable_reason_codes constant), (ii) recompute the terminal reason_code from the history's last non-terminal event where present, (iii) tag the hold record itself with retryable=true when the block is ADMISSION_UNRESOLVED. Either (i) or (iii) is the smallest change.
